detail: the legacy checkbox is not offered in this build. Certificate section text: Certificates (advanced) Custom CA certificate file Optional. Absolute path to a PEM file with the certificate authority that signed your server's certificate. It is added to the certificates this computer already trusts (the built-in public list and, where VS Code can read it, the operating system's store), so public servers still work. This is the safe way to trust a private server. Trusted server certificate No certificate has been trusted by hand. The server's certificate is checked the normal way. Review server certificate… For a private or self-signed server without a CA file: shows who the certificate is for, its dates and its SHA-256 fingerprint, and trusts exactly that one certificate if you agree. If the server later presents a different one, the connection is refused until you review it again. Test Connection offers this when it meets a certificate problem.
